portfolio\\2d-product-configurator.html:
The 2D Product Configurator is a web-based solution designed to visualize product variations. This innovative tool uses rendered high-quality product images, which are swapped out based on user interface choices made by customers. As users select different options, the product price is updated in real-time, and the total cost of the product is calculated accordingly.
By allowing customers to see the product with their selected customizations, the 2D Product Configurator enhances the shopping experience, making it more interactive and personalized. This tool not only helps customers to better understand the product and its variations but also provides immediate feedback on the cost implications of their choices. The dynamic price updating feature ensures transparency and helps in building trust with the customers. Overall, the 2D Product Configurator streamlines the decision-making process, leading to increased customer satisfaction and potentially higher sales conversions.
portfolio\\360-virtual-showroom.html: A 360 virtual showroom is an effective solution for businesses to welcome customers to explore their showroom from the comfort of their own homes. This WebGL-based solution is developed using multiple panoramic images from different hotspots, replicating the features of a physical showroom. Users can access the virtual showroom from the business website and navigate through it to learn about products and services. They can also purchase products and services directly from the showroom, with a seamless redirect to the product page for completing the purchase. To enhance the overall experience, customized branding assets and audiovisual elements can be integrated as needed.
portfolio\\3d-commerce-ar.html: This solution is a web-based 3D model and Augmented Reality (AR) viewer. The concept is to display 3D products instead of just a product image on an e-commerce single product page. The product’s 3D model is converted and optimized for the web, allowing it to be viewed from any angle through touch or mouse interaction. The 3D model can also be viewed in AR from the 3D viewer by pressing “View in AR,” which helps customers see the product before making a purchase decision. Additionally, it is integrated with a product variation menu, allowing users to change the texture and color of the product.
portfolio\\3d-commerce-product-viewer.ht: A WebGL-based 3D product viewer, it helps e-commerce customers view life-sized products effectively instead of just seeing product images and videos. The concept is to display the product in a 3D setup and environment with high-quality real-time rendering, so users get an accurate idea of the product’s highest quality. The product’s 3D model is converted and optimized for the web, allowing it to be viewed from any angle through touch or mouse interaction. Users can also switch between interior and studio setups to view the product’s presentation quality. As an e-commerce-based solution, the product batch process is integrated by default. For multiple products, by passing the product SKU in the API parameter, the solution will dynamically display the specific product from the asset server without third-party intervention

portfolio\\anti-tobacco-survey-app.html:
The project aimed to conduct an Anti-Tobacco Survey on Youth for the National Heart Foundation (NHF), with support from the Centers for Disease Control (CDC). This digital survey system minimizes human errors and enhances data security.
I have developed a mobile application for conducting the survey, featuring color-coded multiple-choice questions and guided multilingual voiceovers for adolescent interviewers. To ensure the survey runs smoothly in rural areas, I’ve integrated an asynchronous syncing system that effectively manages data between offline and online databases. The app also includes a resume feature to handle interruptions caused by app crashes.
Additionally, the survey automation solution integrates with a web-based Admin System, providing a comprehensive solution for managing the entire survey process.

The Interactive Penalty Shootout is a new creation designed to ignite genuine football excitement for both young and old. The Kinect device tracks the user’s body movements as the controller, while the goalkeeper is displayed on the projector/screen. When the player kicks the air, the Kinect camera system detects the movement and calculates the direction and force of the shot in real time. Our game system then activates the 3D-animated goalkeeper, who attempts to block the ball. The only real element in this Virtual Penalty Shootout is the player’s foot; everything else—the ball, the goal, and the goalkeeper—exists only virtually on the screen.

portfolio\\physiotrack.html:
A guided physiotherapy assessment system that involves computer vision technology using Kinect device to detect body joints. The application calculates angle to determine the proper quality of exercise done by patients prescribed by doctors. The application provides digital assessment report on exercises done by patients. Patient data was maintained securely though database and application process data though API endpoints.
Patients can do selected exercises from this module. A 3d model will demonstrate the exercise and patient needs to do the exercise accordingly. Patient’s body angle of that exercise will then track through Kinect depth camera and based on that, a repetition counter will count the exercise upon reaching the desired angle of the relevant exercise. Additionally, a strength indicator of angles, a time feedback of doing exercise, repetition counter, angle value & exercise name are some components that are present in this module. After successfully completing an exercise, a UI will pop up to redirect the user to the dashboard & sending data to database.
Patient can access to the exercise selection module, Exercise summary module, Report generation module & settings module.

                                news platforms. The animation leverages editorial typography, bold headlines and a
                                fast-paced news aesthetic to reinforce the brand's identity as a trusted, modern media
                                voice.
designer/portfolio\\citybank-animation.h:
A sophisticated brand animation developed for City Bank, designed to communicate
                                financial trust and innovation through refined motion design. Clean geometric
                                transitions, premium typography and a structured colour palette reflect the bank's
                                commitment to excellence and customer confidence.
designer/portfolio\\dhaka-rock-fest.html:
An electrifying motion graphic identity piece for Dhaka Rock Fest, Bangladesh's premier
                                outdoor music festival. Distorted typography, grunge textures and energetic animation
                                sequences capture the raw power of live rock music and drive audience anticipation for
                                the annual event.
designer/portfolio\\hatil-animations.htm:
A series of premium brand animations produced for Hatil, Bangladesh's leading furniture
                                manufacturer. Showcasing craftsmanship, material quality and interior lifestyle through
                                fluid motion and elegant product cinematics, each piece is designed to elevate the
                                brand's premium market positioning.
designer/portfolio\\healthy-food.html:
A fresh and appetising motion design piece for a healthy food brand, using warm colour
                                palettes, organic textures and mouth-watering ingredient animations to communicate
                                nutrition and wellbeing. Ideal for social media advertising, the piece drives consumer
                                engagement through visual appetite appeal.
designer/portfolio\\linkedsage.html:
A sleek product animation for LinkedSage, a professional networking and AI-powered career
                                platform. The motion design highlights the tool's smart features through clean UI
                                animation, data visualisation and modern kinetic typography, positioning LinkedSage as
                                the go-to platform for career growth.
designer/portfolio\\little-world.html:
Little World is a whimsical motion graphic piece crafted to evoke a sense of wonder and
                                nostalgia. Using miniature-scale visual aesthetics and vibrant color grading, this
                                project brings a playful yet polished visual narrative to life, perfectly suited for
                                children's brand campaigns and social storytelling.
designer/portfolio\\live-concert.html:
A high-impact motion graphic production capturing the energy and atmosphere of a live
                                concert event. Featuring dynamic lighting effects, crowd visualisations and stage
                                graphics, the piece serves as both a promotional asset and an immersive digital
                                experience for music audiences.
A heartfelt commemorative motion design piece honoring International Mother Language Day,
                                celebrating Bangladesh's legacy of linguistic sacrifice. Elegant calligraphy-inspired
                                typography, cultural motifs and an emotive colour palette unite to deliver a powerful
                                tribute to the Ekushey movement.
designer/portfolio\\prothomalo-award.htm:
A prestigious award ceremony animation crafted for Prothom Alo, designed to honour
                                excellence in various societal and professional categories. Elegant gold and black
                                visuals, ceremonial typography and sweeping motion design transitions create an
                                atmosphere of recognition and gravitas.
A full-scale digital campaign animation produced for Prothom Alo, Bangladesh's largest
                                circulating newspaper. Bold editorial design, dynamic motion typography and strong
                                visual storytelling work in concert to amplify the campaign's message across digital and
                                broadcast channels.
A refined motion design project for Prothom Alo's Prothoma publishing imprint, designed
                                to visually communicate the depth and prestige of Bangladeshi literature. Warm tones,
                                book-inspired typography and elegant animation techniques reflect the brand's cultural
                                authority and intellectual reach.
designer/portfolio\\prothomalo-tvc.html:
A television commercial produced for Prothom Alo, crafted to resonate with a mass
                                audience across broadcast and streaming platforms. The TVC combines investigative
                                journalism aesthetics with emotive storytelling to reinforce the publication's role as
                                Bangladesh's most trusted news voice.
designer/portfolio\\prothomalo-wc-campai:
A World Cup campaign animation developed for Prothom Alo, merging the excitement of
                                international cricket with the newspaper's editorial identity. Stadium energy, team
                                colours and high-speed motion graphics drive audience engagement throughout the
                                tournament season.
designer/portfolio\\radhuni.html:
A vibrant and aromatic brand animation produced for Radhuni, Bangladesh's beloved spice
                                brand. Rich warm tones, ingredient visual storytelling and dynamic food styling
                                cinematics bring the essence of Bangladeshi home cooking to life, driving strong brand
                                affinity across digital platforms.
designer/portfolio\\scb-mens-day.html:
A purpose-driven motion design piece created for Standard Chartered Bank's International
                                Men's Day campaign. Thoughtful messaging, clean visual design and emotive storytelling
                                come together to celebrate modern masculinity and the bank's commitment to inclusive
                                brand values.
designer/portfolio\\scb-saadiq.html:
A sophisticated brand animation for Standard Chartered Bank's Saadiq Islamic banking
                                division. Geometric patterns inspired by Islamic artistry, a refined teal and gold
                                palette and dignified motion design communicate the heritage, trust and financial
                                excellence of Sharia-compliant banking.
designer/portfolio\\timeless-tryon.html:
TimelessTryon is an immersive virtual try-on experience visualization crafted for a
                                fashion-forward brand. The animation demonstrates seamless AR clothing transitions,
                                blending product design with cutting-edge motion design to elevate the digital shopping
                                experience.
designer/portfolio\\wynn-slot.html:
A high-gloss commercial animation produced for Wynn's slot gaming experience, combining
                                luxury casino aesthetics with kinetic reel motion design. Rich gold, crimson and black
                                visuals, dynamic coin animations, and premium typography create an immersive preview
                                that appeals to high-value gaming audiences.
gamedev/portfolio\\acme-raffle-draw.html:
I have developed an automated raffle draw system for Bashundhara Group to help organizers initiate
                raffle draws efficiently. My system processes participants’ information and gift item details from CSV
                inputs and automatically generates a dynamic raffle draw. The range for selecting winners can be easily
                adjusted according to requirements. The system produces a list of winners in a CSV file, which
                organizers can use as needed. Additionally, it features audio and visual effects to make the raffle draw
                entertaining throughout.

gamedev/portfolio\\beatthespeed-game.htm:
Speed brings to you “Beat The Speed” game. Run & Cross the distance in a forest.
                Beat The Speed features challenging physics-based gameplay and hours of replay value. Each level

gamedev/portfolio\\dhl-raffle-draw.html:
I have developed an automated raffle draw system for DHL that helps organizers initiate raffle draws
                effectively. My system processes participants’ information and gift item details from CSV inputs and

gamedev/portfolio\\kiloflight-game.html:
Kilo Flight is an augmented reality game on a mission of 1971 with complete army camp setup .The basic
                premise has it takes into the real war environment of Bangladeshi Liberation war. Its a first person
                shooter game .The shooter will shoot from the sky level which will give them the feel of staying in a
                copter. As an added challenge, A Mortar consecutively targeting shooter to destroy. The Shooter will
                have to save his life from the missile and will try to destroy all the element to be the high scorer.
gamedev/portfolio\\node-9.html: Node 9 is a puzzle-based casual 2D game. The game mechanic involves connecting a total of nine nodes with a line without overlapping. The sequence in which the nodes are selected is generated randomly, making each level unique. The game features multilingual support and includes ad network implementation.
gamedev/portfolio\\sixer.html: Sixer is a 2.5D flick cricket game where players use finger flicks to score runs from the incoming ball. The challenge is that the ball swings randomly, so players must anticipate where it will turn. The game features branding placements and a team selection process during onboarding.
gamedev/portfolio\\thedetached-game.html:
Detached is an addictive puzzle based platformer game for PC platforms developed by us. It is a story of
                a lost boy who needed to discover his kidnapped parents on the era of war. The calamity of war and
                troops are active for shoot to kill. Player has to find a way out to bring the boy back to his parents
                solving every level.
